items.evidence: Public product and readiness surfaces are designed separately from authenticated learner, family, teacher and school records; public readiness inputs remain browser-local and these public surfaces do not require production learner records.

Production authorization now uses canonical teacher_classes for teacher/class authority across the certified pilot chain, with class-group management also bound to current teacher membership and current learner enrollment. Twenty previously safe legacy class-teacher assignments were reconciled into canonical authority. Thirteen stale legacy teacher_id values (owner, parent or no same-school membership) no longer confer teacher-specific authority. One current-teacher class remains on a bounded compatibility fallback because its class record has no subject identity and teacher_classes currently requires subject_id. VibeSchool still does not represent the complete learner → teacher → family → school matrix as universally end-to-end certified.

Production teacher assignment authority is rooted in teacher_classes, whose authenticated mutation path is restricted to authorized school administration and requires a current same-school teacher membership for the assigned teacher. Standalone classes.teacher_id is no longer accepted as an independent teacher-authority source by live RLS policies.
The published Privacy Policy states stronger safeguards for children, purpose-limited access, data-subject rights and no sale of personal data.

The public Privacy Policy defines purpose-based retention and deletion/de-identification when data is no longer required; record-by-record operational retention schedules still require deployment-specific validation.
Public trust policy keeps consequential educational and authority decisions evidence-aware and appropriately human-led rather than presenting automation as unrestricted authority.
Public Trust and Contact surfaces provide a route for security, privacy, learner-safety and account concerns without asking people to publish credentials or sensitive learner data.
Migration is scoped from the buyer's actual source data, identifiers and relationships; VibeSchool does not claim a universal one-click migration for every school system.
PWA and public browser certification exist, but workflow-specific offline completeness and field conditions must be tested for the deployment a school intends to depend on.
Public institutional price and contractual SLA are deliberately not invented before value, support capacity and deployment commitments are formally established.
